messages:
Anita: Quick brainstorm: we need a compact benchmark narrative for the launch that ties latency to dollar outcomes. Outputs: 3 chart concepts, one-line headline per chart, and a routing matrix for inbound leads (self-serve vs sales).
Mason: I'll mock charts. My ideas: (1) cost vs sequence length with ms/token overlay, (2) per-workload cost comparison (chat vs batch vs embedding-heavy), (3) optimization stack showing incremental savings from batching/cache/quant.
Priya: Add a single infographic that explains "When to pick Dedicated" — show thresholds (qps, tokens/day, latency SLO) and expected unit cost delta. That will help SDRs.
Carlos: For CTAs: Self-serve = "Start Hosted Free Trial"; Sales = "Talk to a Performance Engineer". Routing: if org tokens/day > 75k OR sustained p95 latency > 300ms -> tag for sales.
eng-bot: (automated) Noted: will create workflow "bench-launch-qualifier" and emit event to #crm when criteria matched.
Anita: Draft chart headlines: A) "Where sequence length eats latency (and cost)" B) "Chat vs batch: compare per-million token economics" C) "Optimization ladder: batching, caching, quantization = $ saved"
Mason: Quick specs: Chart A bins: 0-64,65-256,257-1024; primary y=ms/token, secondary y=$/1M tokens. Chart B: grouped bars for workloads with base vs quantized. Chart C: waterfall with % savings annotated.
Priya: UX notes: label example queries per bin on Chart A (quick reply, blog post, long doc). Make colors colorblind accessible and add a small footnote about baseline model & hardware.
Carlos: Routing matrix draft: Trial <75k tokens/day -> marketing nurture; 75k-250k -> SDR outreach; >250k or enterprise domain -> AE handoff with priority flag. Also route webinar registrants who attend demo to SDRs.
Anita: A/B messaging plan: Variant 1 = data-first (engineer), Variant 2 = outcome-first (PM/CTO). We'll run for 2 weeks and compare conversion and lead qualification.
Mason: Timeline: chart PNGs + interactive slider mock by EOD; landing copy + A/B variants by tomorrow; ops workflow ready by launch.
Priya: One more: include a tiny modal on the landing with a single configurable input: "your average sequence length" -> shows estimated $/month at current usage. Good lead magnet and qualifies intent.
eng-bot: (automated) Workflow created: bench-launch-qualifier. Will post events to #crm with tags and snapshot on match.
Anita: Great. Owners: Mason=charts+interactive, Priya=UX+lead magnet, Carlos=routing+CRM mapping, eng-bot=automation. I'll compile and push a slide draft; share PR when ready.
